description: Make a button from items (Object > Interactive > Convert to Button) or an empty button at a rectangle, with a name, PDF description and Rollover/Click appearances (Buttons and Forms panel)

appearances.description: Appearances to add besides Normal; each starts as a copy of the Normal appearance

bounds.description: Where to make it: a rectangle on a page, in mm from the page's top-left corner (all five values)

description.description: Description: the tooltip and alternative text in the PDF (PDF Options)

target.description: Items to convert: they become the Normal appearance (give this or bounds)

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

name: create_button
title: Create Button
